skill.name: researching-best-practices
skill.description: Researches software engineering best practices and turns them into context-specific recommendations for implementation, architecture, API design, security, performance, testing, and code quality.
skill.summary: Researches trusted engineering guidance and adapts it to a project context.
skill.author: C0ntr0lledCha0s

security_audit.summary: The static findings are false positives caused by markdown code fences, inline paths, checklist wording, and illustrative API examples. I found no prompt injection, data exfiltration intent, or executable malware behavior in the reviewed files. The author should clarify shell examples to reduce conservative scanner alerts.

remediation.issue: Shell examples in SKILL.md may be interpreted as executable automation.
remediation.suggestion: Mark shell commands as illustrative, require explicit user approval, or remove references to helper scripts that are not packaged.

remediation.issue: A clickable example URL triggered a network pattern alert.
remediation.suggestion: Use a reserved placeholder domain or plain text placeholder for API examples that should not be fetched.

remediation.issue: Unlabeled markdown fences triggered command-execution heuristics.
remediation.suggestion: Label non-executable fences as text or markdown so static analysis can separate prose from commands.

content.value_statement: Teams often need relevant engineering guidance, but generic advice can miss project constraints. This skill researches trusted sources and local context to recommend practical implementation approaches.
actual_capabilities: Guides a three-phase process for understanding context, researching options, and forming recommendations.
Compares implementation approaches with pros, cons, trade-offs, and migration concerns.
Covers security, performance, testing, code quality, API design, and architecture topics.
Prioritizes official documentation, standards bodies, trusted community resources, and academic sources.
Provides a structured recommendation format with context, rationale, alternatives, and implementation guidance.
Includes reference checklists for API design, code quality, performance, and security practices.
limitations: It provides research guidance, not automated enforcement or guaranteed correctness.
Listed helper scripts are not included in this package.
Some source-priority guidance references 2025 and should be verified against current documentation.
Web research depends on available tools, source access, and source quality.

use_cases.title: Choose an implementation approach
use_cases.description: Compare practical options for a feature and select one that fits project constraints.

use_cases.title: Review architecture decisions
use_cases.description: Evaluate architecture patterns against scale, complexity, team skills, and maintainability goals.

use_cases.title: Prepare engineering standards
use_cases.description: Create checklists and recommendation summaries for API design, security, quality, or performance practices.

prompt_templates.title: Find a Best Practice
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a recommended approach.
prompt_templates.prompt: Research the best practice for [task] in a [stack] project. Include the recommended approach, alternatives, and trade-offs.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Implementation Options
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request with two or more choices.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [option A] and [option B] for [project context]. Recommend one approach and explain migration concerns.

prompt_templates.title: Review Existing Approach
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request that includes current code or design.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [file or design] against current best practices for [domain]. Identify strengths, risks, and concrete improvements.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Decision Framework
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for a repeatable evaluation method.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a decision matrix for [technology or architecture choice]. Weigh maintainability, security, performance, cost, and team experience.

output_examples.input: What is the best way to manage authentication in a React app?
output_examples.output: A recommendation comparing HttpOnly cookies, OIDC providers, and token storage risks, followed by a primary approach and security notes.

output_examples.input: Is our API versioning strategy sound?
output_examples.output: A structured assessment covering versioning style, deprecation policy, migration guidance, documentation needs, and common pitfalls.

output_examples.input: Should we use microservices for this new product?
output_examples.output: A trade-off analysis that weighs complexity, team size, deployment maturity, scalability needs, and simpler alternatives.

best_practices: Provide the stack, constraints, and success criteria before asking for recommendations.
Ask for trade-offs and source priority when the answer affects architecture or security.
Validate current standards with official documentation before implementing major changes.
anti_patterns: Do not apply a pattern only because it is popular.
Do not ask for universal best practices without project context.
Do not treat the output as a substitute for security, compliance, or legal review.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps research software engineering best practices and turn them into context-specific recommendations.

faq.question: Does it run audits automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and checklists. Any automated checks require separate tooling.

faq.question: Can it use current web sources?
faq.answer: Yes, when web tools are available. Important decisions should still verify official documentation.

faq.question: Which topics are covered?
faq.answer: It covers architecture, API design, security, performance, testing, and code quality practices.

faq.question: Is this useful for existing code?
faq.answer: Yes. It can compare existing patterns against best practices and suggest improvements.

faq.question: Are helper scripts included?
faq.answer: No. The package references scripts, but the scanned files do not include a scripts directory.
